evidence.claim: tests/test_solver.py contains exactly 13 test methods; the largest literal instance has 8 jobs; zero occurrences of any timing/instrumentation/scaling token; no test varies len(jobs) programmatically or counts operations.

python -m unittest discover -s tests collects exactly those 13 tests; none of probes.py's r8_* probes are collected — probes.py is outside the suite, so suite-level R8-runtime protection cannot be credited to it.

A mild super-polynomial surrogate (canonical solve + busy-loop of int(3000*1.02**n) iterations, genuinely exponential) passes probes.py's r8_scaling 30s wall-clock cap (ok=True) and the full 24-probe matrix: even if probes.py were in the suite, its wall-clock-threshold form does not discriminate mild-base exponential regressions.

An exponential surrogate in exactly the violation class R8 names (unmemoized include/exclude recursion, Theta(2^n) nodes), verified R5/R6-equivalent to oracle enumeration on 13,825 exhaustive small instances (0 mismatches) and R1-equivalent on rejection spot checks (8/8), passes the entire canonical suite 13/13 via staged import shim. This is the executable H1 witness: tests/ cannot distinguish the named violation class from the canonical solver.

A justified deterministic discriminator exists: sys.settrace trace-event counts on the disjoint instance family, asserted per doubling of n with bound 32 (=2^5, admits any polynomial of degree <= 5). Measured per-doubling ratios: canonical 4.98-6.86; fresh higher-degree polynomial control 5.46-7.15 (no false positive); exponential surrogate 103.6-442.67 at its capped schedule (flagged; cap justified because polynomial ratios are degree-bounded at every n while enumeration ratios diverge). Counts exactly reproducible run-to-run; assertion is on ratios, so no environment- or implementation-specific constant is encoded.

Causally distinct verification ACCEPTed the candidate 7/7: with freshly re-authored surrogates (iterative bitmask enumerator, ratios 149.3/660.2 > 32; start-sorted suffix-DP polynomial, candidate passes 14/14), candidate+canonical 14/14, candidate FAILS the fresh exponential surrogate with failure identity exactly the new test (no hang: incremental assertions fail at n=16), pure-addition diff audit, canonical tree git-clean, canonical suite 13/13, probes 24/24.

R8's runtime clause reads NARROW, not AMBIGUOUS: 'Runtime MUST be polynomial in len(jobs) (exhaustive subset enumeration is not acceptable)' anchors the obligation to a named concrete violation class; no degree bound is stated or implied elsewhere in the spec.

Fixed logical limit (execution-independent): no finite set of timed or counted runs can certify asymptotic polynomiality for all n; 'mechanically testable' for R8-runtime can only mean deterministic discrimination of concrete violation classes, first of all the class R8 itself names. Any coverage verdict is scoped accordingly.

R8 sub-clause mapping (supported by deterministic greps E1/E2): no-mutation has 1 suite test; determinism has 0 suite tests (only out-of-suite probes); runtime has 0 suite tests. The verdict is scoped strictly to the runtime sub-clause.

Recorded residual risks of the discriminator: (a) super-polynomial growth with base near 1 (e.g. 1.02^n) evades any fixed finite test — unavoidable per E8, applies equally to wall-clock forms; (b) work executed entirely inside C extensions emits no trace events — implausible for a hand-written scheduling regression; (c) ratio bound 32 would false-positive on a legitimate polynomial of degree > 5 — the spec permits any degree, so this admittance line is a judgment, made with 4.7x headroom over the highest measured legitimate ratio.

M3's unresolved item ('R8 polynomial-runtime still has no unit-suite coverage') was used ONLY as task motivation, never as evidence: the gap was re-demonstrated fresh (E4). oracle.py's R2/R5/R6 correctness is inherited from Experiment 2/3 audits; both this experiment's evidence and verify nodes used it for surrogate admissibility, and its enumeration logic was additionally cross-checked here by two independently authored surrogates agreeing with it on 13,825 instances each.
